about: Evidence-library retrieval test set: questions a procurement planner would type, over the live corpus (PAD / ISR / ICR reports for KE, GH, NP, BD, VN, RW). 'theme' questions span the portfolio; 'project' questions name one operation; 'offtopic' questions have no answer in the corpus (the library should return nothing). Relevance labels are in retrieval_labels.json, produced by evals/retrieval_eval.py.
